human_feedback_verbatim:
First assess whether the existing block is likely to cover the attack; if not, prefer legal damage such as Rampage to reduce enemy count or shorten the fight rather than spending the last energy on marginal additional block.
When removing cards, prioritize removing equal number of strikes and defends if there are no curses in ur deck
versus the big slime boss in particular, when the slimes are half hp they will split into 2, so try to maximise damage to below half of the slime's hp so that it will split into 2 slimes with lower hp. 
do not prioritize getting the keys, u should prioritize immediate survival and good relics over the keys.
